import zipfile
import re
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

NS = {
    "m": "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main",
    "r": "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships",
}

path = "budget.xlsx"
with zipfile.ZipFile(path) as z:
    print("=== Archive contents ===")
    for n in z.namelist():
        print(n)

    wb_xml = z.read("xl/workbook.xml").decode("utf-8")
    root = ET.fromstring(wb_xml)
    sheets = root.find("m:sheets", NS)
    print("\n=== Sheets ===")
    for s in sheets:
        print(s.attrib)

    # shared strings
    shared = []
    if "xl/sharedStrings.xml" in z.namelist():
        ss_root = ET.fromstring(z.read("xl/sharedStrings.xml"))
        for si in ss_root.findall("m:si", NS):
            text = "".join(t.text or "" for t in si.iter(f"{{{NS['m']}}}t"))
            shared.append(text)
    print("\n=== Shared strings count:", len(shared))

    # worksheet files
    wb_rel = ET.fromstring(z.read("xl/_rels/workbook.xml.rels").decode("utf-8"))
    rels = {}
    for rel in wb_rel:
        rels[rel.attrib["Id"]] = rel.attrib["Target"]
    for s in sheets:
        rid = s.attrib[f"{{{NS['r']}}}id"]
        target = rels[rid]
        if not target.startswith("xl/"):
            target = "xl/" + target.lstrip("/")
        print(f"\n=== Sheet '{s.attrib['name']}' -> {target} ===")
        ws_root = ET.fromstring(z.read(target))
        for row in ws_root.iter(f"{{{NS['m']}}}row"):
            r = row.attrib.get("r")
            cells = []
            for c in row.findall(f"{{{NS['m']}}}c"):
                ref = c.attrib.get("r")
                t = c.attrib.get("t")
                v = c.find(f"{{{NS['m']}}}v")
                val = None
                if v is not None:
                    if t == "s":
                        val = shared[int(v.text)]
                    elif t == "inlineStr":
                        is_el = c.find(f"{{{NS['m']}}}is")
                        val = "".join(tt.text or "" for tt in is_el.iter(f"{{{NS['m']}}}t"))
                    else:
                        val = v.text
                cells.append((ref, val))
            print("row", r, cells)
